message:
Running command: python3 << 'EOF'
data = open('/workspace/testcase','rb').read()
offset = 8
for entry_num in range(10):
    if offset + 60 > len(data):
        print(f'Entry {entry_num}: offset {offset} out of bounds')
        break
    hdr = data[offset:offset+60]
    ar_name = hdr[0:16]
    ar_size = hdr[48:58]
    ar_fmag = hdr[58:60]
    print(f'Entry {entry_num} at offset {offset}:')
    print(f'  ar_name: {ar_name!r}')
    print(f'  ar_size: {ar_size!r}')
    print(f'  ar_fmag: {ar_fmag!r}')
    if ar_size[9:10] != b' ':
        buf = ar_size + b'\x00'
        string = buf
    else:
        string = ar_size
    print(f'  ar_size bytes: {list(ar_size)}')
    if ar_name == b'//' + b' ' * 14:
        print('  *** This is the // entry ***')
        break
    import re
    s = string.rstrip(b'\x00').decode('latin1')
    m = re.match(r'\s*([+-]?\d+)', s)
    if m:
        val = int(m.group(1))
    else:
        val = 0
    print(f'  atol result: {val}')
    offset += 60 + ((val + 1) & ~1)
    print(f'  Next offset: {offset}')
EOF
